title: Source integrability and the frontier $α=\tfrac12$ in time-fractional diffusion
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^{d}$ be a bounded Lipschitz domain, let $α\in(0,1)$, and let $\partial_{t}^α$ denote the Caputo derivative. For $\partial_{t}^αu-\nabla\cdot\bigl(A(x)\nabla u\bigr)=f$ with homogeneous Dirichlet condition and initial datum $g\in L^{2}(Ω)$, we identify which of the thresholds appearing in the energy method belong to the method and which to the equation. We compare $f\in L^{2}\bigl((0,T);L^{2}(Ω)\bigr)$ and $f\in L^{r}\bigl((0,T);L^{2}(Ω)\bigr)$ with $r>2/α$; in the subdiffusive range the second implies the first and not conversely.
